What is Ondo (ONDO)?
Published: Feb 4, 2025
Table of Contents
Ondo Finance is a decentralized finance (DeFi) platform that bridges the gap between traditional finance (TradFi) and blockchain technology by tokenizing real-world assets (RWAs). By bringing institutional-grade financial products onto the blockchain, Ondo aims to create a more accessible, transparent, and efficient financial ecosystem.
The History of Ondo
Ondo Finance was founded to make institutional-grade financial products accessible to everyone. Traditionally, these opportunities were limited to banks, hedge funds, and accredited investors. By leveraging blockchain technology, Ondo is breaking down these barriers and bringing real-world assets (RWAs) into the DeFi space.
To achieve this, Ondo has:

Partnered with institutional asset managers to enable the tokenization of RWAs.
Launched Ondo DAO, giving governance power to the community.
Expanded access to institutional DeFi, attracting both crypto and traditional finance investors.

Ondo Features
Tokenization of Real-World Assets (RWAs)
Ondo converts bonds, funds, and securities into digital tokens, making them easier to trade, more transparent, and accessible to a wider range of investors.
Blockchain as Middleware
Ondo acts as a bridge between TradFi and DeFi, ensuring seamless integration, security through smart contracts, and regulatory compliance for institutional adoption.
Institutional-Grade Financial Products
Unlike crypto assets, Ondo offers regulated investment options like:

USDY – A stablecoin yield product with predictable returns.
OUSG – A tokenized fund backed by BlackRock, offering institutional-grade exposure.

Governance & Decentralization
The ONDO token gives holders voting power over protocol fees, smart contract updates, and DAO governance, ensuring the community shapes Ondo’s future.
ONDO: The Token
The ONDO token serves as both the governance and utility token within the Ondo ecosystem. As a governance token, ONDO holders can vote on key protocol changes, including economic policies, feature upgrades, and smart contract improvements. This ensures that the community has a voice in shaping the future of Ondo Finance.
Beyond governance, ONDO also helps oversee Flux Finance and the Ondo DAO, maintaining a decentralized and adaptive ecosystem. While ONDO does not represent ownership of any underlying financial assets, it grants holders the ability to influence protocol decisions.

In Brief
Learn about Ondo, its use cases on RWA, the ecosystem, and the ONDO token. Explore how to swap the ONDO token using Trust Wallet.

Ondo Finance is a pioneering platform that bridges the gap between traditional financial assets and blockchain technology. By tokenizing real-world assets (RWAs), like bonds and exchange-traded funds (ETFs), Ondo democratizes access to institutional-grade financial products and offers innovative solutions to investors.
The market for asset tokenization is projected to reach $15 trillion by the end of the decade. Ondo Finance is strategically positioned to capitalize on this growth. Ondo represents a significant advancement in integrating traditional finance with blockchain technology by offering financial products catering to retail and institutional investors.
This beginner's guide explores Ondo's core functionalities, its role in tokenizing real-world assets, the ecosystem surrounding it, and the significance of the Ondo token.

Before You Get Started
Remember that you can use Trust Wallet as your secure ONDO wallet. Buy, sell, and swap crypto all in one place.
Trust Wallet also lets you manage and interact with 10M+ crypto assets across 100+ blockchains. Download the latest version of Trust Wallet today.

What is Ondo Finance?
Operating as an open, decentralized bank, Ondo improves upon DeFi-TradFi connectivity, enabling institutional-grade products, such as US treasury-backed tokens, to be brought on-chain. Ondo Finance focuses on tokenizing real-world assets, including bonds and exchange-traded funds (ETFs). Launched in 2021, Ondo makes financial services available to everyone, by providing a regulated environment for trading tokenized securities. Ondo gained traction when interest in RWAs surged, highlighting the potential for integrating traditional finance with blockchain technology.

Use Cases of Ondo in Real-World Asset Tokenization
Ondo Finance is at the forefront of a movement to tokenize real-world assets, which involves creating digital representations of physical assets on a blockchain. The tokenization process enhances liquidity and makes these assets accessible to a broader audience. Some key use cases include:


Tokenized U.S. Treasuries: Ondo offers products like USDY, which are backed by U.S. Treasuries. This enables investors to gain exposure to stable, low-risk assets while benefiting from the advantages of blockchain technology, such as 24/7 trading and lower transaction costs.


Institutional-grade financial products: Ondo provides fixed-yield loans backed by yield-generating crypto assets. This approach enables investors to earn returns similar to traditional fixed-income securities but with the added benefits of DeFi, such as transparency and reduced reliance on intermediaries.


Cross-chain asset movement: The Ondo platform supports multiple blockchains, including Ethereum, Solana, and Aptos, enabling seamless asset transfers and enhancing liquidity across different networks. Interoperability is important for attracting a diverse range of users and investors.



The Ondo Ecosystem
The Ondo ecosystem is built through collaboration with various partners and service providers to enhance its offerings. Ondo collaborates with centralized exchanges (CEXs), over-the-counter (OTC) desks, and decentralized finance (DeFi) protocols to ensure liquidity for its tokenized products. This network enables users to access capital efficiently and securely.
Trust and security are essential in the crypto sector. Ondo partners with reputable custodians and asset managers, such as BlackRock and Morgan Stanley, to ensure the safety of investors' assets. Ondo’s commitment to transparency and risk management is fundamental to building investor confidence.
The ONDO token serves as the governance token for the Ondo Finance platform. Token holders can participate in decision-making processes, influencing protocol upgrades, economic parameters, and other critical aspects of the platform. Their decentralized governance lets the community have a say and ensures that user interests align with the platform's growth.
The ONDO Token
The ONDO token is integral to the Ondo Finance ecosystem, serving multiple purposes:


Governance: The ONDO token enables holders to participate in the governance of the Ondo ecosystem. This includes voting on key protocol matters such as economic parameters, smart contract upgrades, and overall management of the Ondo DAO (Decentralized Autonomous Organization).


Ecosystem growth: A significant portion of the total supply of ONDO tokens (52.1%) is allocated for ecosystem growth. This allocation incentivizes users to hold and engage with the platform, rewarding them for their participation in governance and other activities.


The total supply of ONDO is capped at 10 billion tokens, with an initial unlocked supply of 1.4 billion. The distribution is structured to avoid inflation, with tokens allocated for various purposes and vested over time. The token has gained significant market interest, reaching a market capitalization of over $1 billion shortly after its public launch in January 2024.

Relationship with Ethereum
Ondo Finance launched its first products, including the ONDO token, on the Ethereum blockchain. This choice of blockchain enables Ondo to use Ethereum's established infrastructure and security features, enabling the tokenization of traditional assets like U.S. Treasuries and money market funds.
While initially launched on Ethereum, Ondo Finance has expanded its operations to include other blockchains, such as Solana and Cosmos. This cross-chain capability enhances its reach and usability across different platforms, but Ethereum remains a foundational element of its ecosystem.
How to Swap ETH for ONDO
You can swap crypto, including ONDO, using Trust Wallet, via our trusted partners. Here’s how:


Select “Swap” from the Trust Wallet home screen.


Ensure Ethereum is selected in the “From” network field, and choose ETH as your token


Ensure Ethereum is selected in the “To” network field, and choose ONDO as your token.


Enter the amount of ETH you would like to swap.


Select “Continue” and complete the remaining steps.




Conclusion
Ondo Finance is a significant advancement in the integration of traditional finance with blockchain technology. By tokenizing real-world assets and offering a range of financial products, Ondo is paving the way for a more inclusive and accessible financial ecosystem. As the platform continues to grow and evolve, it will be essential for users to stay informed about its developments, governance opportunities, and market dynamics. With the ONDO token at the heart of its operations, Ondo Finance is poised to play a pivotal role in the future of decentralized finance. Using Trust Wallet as your secure ONDO wallet provides seamless access to innovative features and opportunities within the Ondo ecosystem.

What is the Ondo Foundation?
The Ondo Foundation (formerly known as the Neptune Foundation) was founded in 2022 as an independently governed and nonprofit Cayman Islands Foundation Company with no beneficial owners. The Ondo Foundation assisted in the launch of the Ondo DAO, which deployed and currently governs Flux Finance, the first lending protocol supporting tokenized securities as collateral.

What is the Foundation's mission?
The Ondo Foundation has a mission of democratizing access to institutional-grade finance. We are focused on supporting decentralized protocols like Flux, participating in the Ondo DAO community and, more recently, supporting tokenized real world assets like USDY.  
Notably, the Ondo Foundation, through its subsidiaries, owns 99% of the common equity in Ondo USDY LLC, the issuer of USDY. The Ondo Foundation therefore benefits from the growth of USDY and uses proceeds from this growth in furtherance of its mission.

On which key areas does the Foundation focus?
Ondo Foundation’s mandate is focused on several key areas:

Supporting Innovation: Financing and endorsing projects that responsibly advance the adoption of tokenized real world assets and their use in onchain financial protocols.
Educating and Promoting Awareness: Increasing public understanding of our ecosystem and the benefits of asset tokenization.
Treasury Management: Overseeing a treasury to facilitate strategic ecosystem growth.
Contract Deployment: Issuing governance tokens and deploying protocol smart contracts.
Web Application Management: Hosting web applications for certain platforms in the ecosystem.
Strategic Partnerships and Engagement: Collaborating with businesses, regulators, and other stakeholders.
Intellectual Property Management: Acquiring and handling IP rights.
Community Events and Engagement: Organizing events to strengthen community ties.

The Ondo Foundation also works with Ondo Finance as a commercial partner that is focused on the provision of certain technology and business development services and the management of certain tokenized real world assets like USDY.

What is the ONDO Token?
In mid-2022, Ondo Foundation, through its subsidiaries, sold ONDO tokens to over 18,000 individuals through CoinList. ONDO token holders are entrusted with shaping the future of the Ondo DAO so that it continues to pursue its mission to democratize access to institutional-grade finance. The Ondo DAO gives ONDO holders specific rights pertaining to Flux Finance, which is currently governed by the Ondo DAO.

What is the Ondo Ecosystem?
The Ondo Ecosystem encompasses the full set of partners working with or affiliated with the Ondo Foundation that are aligned with the mission of bringing institutional-grade financial products and services to everyone. Contributors to the Ondo Ecosystem include developers, educators, researchers, partners, and strategic contributors.

The governance process will typically follow a two-stage process: a forum discussion and an on-chain vote.
Governance proposals will typically start with a post on the Flux Finance Governance Forum (opens in a new tab). The post, though optional, is strongly encouraged. Feedback from the community and team will materially increase the chances of a successful and well-aligned governance proposal. Anyone can post and contribute to the discussion on the forum. [...] Once the governance proposal is finalized, you can submit a proposal for a binding on-chain vote. The DAO is a fork of Compound's Governor Bravo (opens in a new tab) and uses Tally to manage the on-chain voting process. Voting power is based on ONDO token ownership, and token holders can delegate their voting power to other wallets.
The DAO parameters are set as follows: [...] Proposal Threshold: 100,000,000 ONDO
To submit a proposal, you need to have this much voting power (directly and/or delegated to you). This rule is necessary to reduce spam or malicious proposals.


Voting Period: 3 days
Once the voting period is live, people will be able to cast votes during this period, after which the proposal becomes binding and can be executed.


Quorum: 1,000,000 ONDO
Proposals will only pass if there is enough voting power to pass the quorum.

The Ondo DAO
The Ondo DAO
Overview
Stakeholders in the DAO — ONDO token holders — exercise control over the protocol, including economic parameters and smart contract upgrades, through on-chain governance proposals.
The DAO might also elect committees or multisigs to manage certain processes, such as updating certain economic parameters or pausing the protocol in critical times.
Governance Process
The governance process will typically follow a two-stage process: a forum discussion and an on-chain vote.
Governance proposals will typically start with a post on the Flux Finance Governance Forum (opens in a new tab). The post, though optional, is strongly encouraged. Feedback from the community and team will materially increase the chances of a successful and well-aligned governance proposal. Anyone can post and contribute to the discussion on the forum.
Once the governance proposal is finalized, you can submit a proposal for a binding on-chain vote. The DAO is a fork of Compound's Governor Bravo (opens in a new tab) and uses Tally to manage the on-chain voting process. Voting power is based on ONDO token ownership, and token holders can delegate their voting power to other wallets.
The DAO parameters are set as follows:

Proposal Threshold: 100,000,000 ONDO
To submit a proposal, you need to have this much voting power (directly and/or delegated to you). This rule is necessary to reduce spam or malicious proposals.


Voting Period: 3 days
Once the voting period is live, people will be able to cast votes during this period, after which the proposal becomes binding and can be executed.


Quorum: 1,000,000 ONDO
Proposals will only pass if there is enough voting power to pass the quorum.


Timelock: 1 day
Successful proposals will execute after this delay period once the voting period completes.
